stops.name: Laki-Krater
stops.detail: The Laki craters (Icelandic Lakagígar) are located in the south of Iceland near the Eldgjá fissure.

stops.name: Eldgjá
stops.detail: The area, to which the Eldgjá also belongs, is known for some of Iceland's most powerful volcanic eruptions.

stops.name: Skaftá
stops.detail: The Skaftá river, through which up to 100 m³/s of water normally flows, dried up completely on June 11th due to evaporation.

stops.name: Hverfisfljót

stops.name: Ytra-Eldhraun
stops.detail: The two lava flows are called Ytra-Eldhraun and Eystra-Eldhraun.
